detail_text: This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice for the procurement of Cabin Pressure Testers IAW the Statement of Work. FOB destination is Tinker AFB, OK. This requirement is a sole source acquisition to Hydraulics International, INC. No quotes can be accepted until the solicitation has been posted. Please send in the actual solicitation completed along with any other documentation to support your company’s quote. Please make sure information stated is readable and legible. This is a Firm Fixed Price procurement, so please state the price on your quote as all inclusive of everything. ( i.e. shipping, taxes, fees, etc.) POC: MADELYN.WIENS@US.AF.MIL
